tone_statements.citation: Li Jinyan 李金艳. 2026. 威宁果濮彝语量词的变调 [Tone sandhi of classifiers in Weining Guopu Yi; Crossref English title 'The Transposition of Quantifiers in Weining Guopu Yi Language']. 现代语言学 (Modern Linguistics, Hans Publishers) 14(7): 373-384.
tone_statements.quote: 贵州威宁果濮彝语隶属彝语东部方言滇黔次方言乌撒土语，量词丰富，研究成果少，特别是量词变调研究成果较少。威宁果濮彝语量词与基数词、概数词及疑问代词“多少”组合连读时，会发生变调。这些连读变调的调值是果濮彝语声调系统中本身具有的，只在原声调系统内进行有条件的选择。 [...] [表 3 单字调: 低降调 21 / 低升调 13 / 中平调 33 / 高平调 55] 单字调读低降调的量词，连读可以有低降、中平、高平三种调型；低升调、中平调和高平调三种量词，连读只有本调一个调型。
tone_statements.translation: The Guopu Yi of Weining, Guizhou belongs to the Wusa vernacular of the Dian-Qian subdialect of the Eastern dialect of Yi; it is rich in classifiers, little studied, and classifier tone sandhi in particular has hardly been studied. When Weining Guopu Yi classifiers are read together with cardinal numerals, approximate numerals and the interrogative 'how many', tone sandhi occurs. The sandhi tone values are ones the Guopu Yi tone system already has; the choice is made, under conditions, within the original tone system. [...] [Table 3, citation tones: low falling 21 / low rising 13 / mid level 33 / high level 55] Classifiers whose citation tone is low falling can surface with three contours in sandhi - low falling, mid level, high level; classifiers of the low-rising, mid-level and high-level tones keep only their own tone in sandhi.
tone_statements.locator: sec. 1 引言, p. 374; Table 1 p. 375; Table 3 and following sentence, p. 380; conclusion sec. 4 pp. 383-384
tone_statements.n_tones: 4 (55 high level, 33 mid level, 13 low rising, 21 low falling)

sources.note: Describes another variety (Glottolog lolo1267). Coda simplification in Tibeto-Burman led, at the Proto-Yi-branch stage, to coda loss that changed syllable laxness/tenseness and pitch, producing a lax tone and a tense tone; initial voicing and vowel length then caused two further splits; Yi-branch tone categories reduce to five classes (松甲一, 松甲二, 松乙, 紧甲, 紧乙). Keywords mention 傈僳语; whether Weining/Wumeng Nasu data are tabulated is not visible - S's clause 'framework into which the Weining/Wumeng four-tone systems are mapped' is inference, not in the record.
